<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-partners-claude-build-decks" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/partners-claude-build-decks/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="Partners have Claude build the decks; juniors check them." markdown>

**Partners have Claude build the decks; juniors check them.** In a thread asking what has changed on the ground, consultants report: "Our partners used to have consultants make decks. Now they have Claude make them and we just check them." One no longer builds models in Excel directly and reviews Claude's output instead; another gets a starter deck "60-70% ready" in minutes. The reported downside: RFPs written by AI and not properly read by the client, which inflate bids. Anonymous accounts, no firm named. [Reddit r/consulting, 4 Nov 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/consulting/comments/1xo3ljb/what_are_on_the_ground_changes_in_consulting_due/)

**McKinsey tests an AI-simulated client in entry-level interviews.** Citing The Wall Street Journal, The Verge reports that some undergraduate business-analyst candidates in North America will hold a 10-minute conversation with an AI client simulation this autumn. The AI does not score candidates; humans in the room assess them. [The Verge, 14 Oct 2026](https://www.theverge.com/news/1011654/mckinsey-ai-client-interview)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-ey-kpmg-want-juniors" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/ey-kpmg-want-juniors/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="EY and KPMG want juniors back in the office as AI takes over technical work." markdown>

**EY and KPMG want juniors back in the office as AI takes over technical work.** EY's UK head of consulting, Sayeh Ghanbari, told the Financial Times that remote-heavy careers are "just not the route to success in the world of AI" and that flexibility will have to be reduced to build human skills. KPMG's UK advisory head made the same point about juniors learning directly from others. [Scottish Financial News, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.scottishfinancialnews.com/articles/junior-staff-to-return-to-office-to-sharpen-human-skills-as-ai-advances)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-mckinsey-golden-age-hiring" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/mckinsey-golden-age-hiring/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="McKinsey&#x27;s global head predicts a golden age for strategy consulting and plans 20% more consultants." markdown>

**McKinsey's global head predicts a golden age for strategy consulting and plans 20% more consultants.** In a Bloomberg interview reported by Consultor, Bob Sternfels said AI and geopolitics will increase the demand for advice, and that the AI-driven restructuring of the firm's support functions is largely finished. He targets 20% growth in consultant headcount, mostly in early-career roles, and says each client-facing consultant now works with about three AI agents. [Consultor, 20 Jul 2026](https://www.consultor.fr/articles/bob-sternfels-annonce-un-age-dor-du-conseil-en-strategie-et-20-de-consultants-en-plus)
